headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
summary: Full-stack engineer with 8+ years of Laravel/PHP and Vue.js, from database design and REST APIs to customer-facing UI. Product-minded, autonomous, and uses AI tools like Claude Code daily.

bullets: Led full-stack development of a Laravel, Vue.js, and MySQL SaaS platform on a fully remote team.
Owned architecture, code reviews, and debugging; partnered with product and design on Figma prototypes.
Wrote PHPUnit tests to grow coverage and worked the Laravel 8 to 10 upgrade path.
Migrated environments to Docker, ran CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and reduced AWS costs by over $6,000/month.
Shipped 11+ full-stack applications with PHP and Laravel REST APIs, Vue.js front-ends, and CI/CD.
Designed object-oriented MVC back-ends and normalized data models.
Optimized hourly data sync from a legacy Oracle schema with seven-table joins into MySQL and PostgreSQL.
Owned projects autonomously, from requirements gathering to documentation and deployment.
